sections.label: Pallavi
sections.ta:
புறம் காட்டலாகாது அம்மா புவனேஸ்வரி
திறம் இதுவோ உனக்கிதுவும் தகுமோ
sections.translit:
puRam kAttalAgAdhu ammA bhuvanEswari
thiRam idhuvO unakkidhuvum thagumO
sections.en: Oh, mother Bhuvaneswari, please do not turn your back on me. Is this proper etiquette? Is this befitting your stature?

sections.label: Anupallavi
sections.ta:
அறம் என்றெண்ணி அபலைக்கு அருள்வாய்
தரம் குறைவு பார்க்கலாகாது தயாபரீ
sections.translit:
aRam endReNNi abalaikku aruLvAy
tharam kuRaivu pArkkalAgAdhu dhayAparI
sections.en: Please consider it justifiable righteousness and bless this destitute soul. As a compassionate goddess, please overlook my flaws for now.

sections.label: Charanam
sections.ta:
இகம் இதுவே சதம் வாழ்வினிலே நிதம்
சுகம் என்றே நினைந்து போக மாயைதனில்
அகம் கொண்டு அழிந்து சோக நிலையிலுன்
முகம் காண பதறியோடி நான் வரும் போது
sections.translit:
igam idhuvE sadham vAzhvinilE nidham
sugam endRe ninaindhu bOga mAyaidhanil
agam koNdu azhindhu sOga nilaiyilun
mugam kANa padhariyOdi nAn varum pOdhu
sections.en: I thought that this present worldly life is permanent, and that it is pleasant  each day. Little did I know that I ruined myself in the vagaries of this illusory existence. When the truth hit me, I came crying and running in utter despair, to see your lovely face. Please do not turn your back on me.

notes:
This is one of many songs I composed spontaneously. I was about to have a darshan of Goddess Parvathi at the Concord Siva Murugan Temple when the curtain fell, and for a moment, I lost my balance. I was puzzled by Ambal’s gesture. With half-formed thoughts of the spirit, I feared perhaps she was not ready to reveal herself. From that trembling uncertainty, this song was born.
Later, I found solace in the profound reflections of Sri C. Rajagopalachari, particularly in his popular composition குறையொன்றும் இல்லை மறை மூர்த்தி கண்ணா(kuRaiyondRum illai maRai mUrtthi kaNNA) on Venkatesa Perumal. I realized that even if Ambal is behind the curtain, she would still bless me, for she is the Goddess of the universe and aware of my plight.
